about: Things he really said on stream, word for word, picked by hand on 2026-11-10 (several rounds) because they still make sense said to Mario or to nobody. Spoken by the voice clone. Each names the rules it may answer and, when it only fits certain places, their level numbers. Picked by ear for his speech habits; the speaker check has not been run, so a line could be a guest's. Lines under the chat_ rules are how he answered his own chat; they answer what the player types in the game chat (data/chat.json).
